<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>site:mvd.dor.ga.gov/tags/index.aspx Georgia vehicle tags registration</query>

Based on my search, I can provide information about this webpage. The URL `mvd.dor.ga.gov/tags/index.aspx` is the **Georgia Department of Revenue - Motor Vehicle Division (MVD) Tags/Registration page**.

This page is part of Georgia's official government website for motor vehicle services and relates to vehicle tag (license plate) registration and related services. The Georgia MVD handles:

- Vehicle registration and tag issuance
- License plate renewals
- Specialty and prestige license plates
- Tag transfer services
- Registration fees and taxes
